mike (Support): FYI customer X reports p99 latency ~2.8s -> 9.2s after we rolled SolsticeV1 yesterday for long documents (>32k tokens). They see failures for streaming too. Logs attached.
anna (SRE): ack, looking. Any repro request IDs or sample payloads?
mike (Support): Request IDs: r_9a3f2c, r_9a3f9d. Sample payload: 40k token doc + prompt. They said p95 also drifted but p99 is worst. Error rate up ~1.3% for that customer.
li (Runtime): I see a cluster-wide increase in kernel stalls around those timestamps. Graph: https://grafana/redwood/d/solstice/onboard-latency
carla (ML Eng): We changed tokenizer merge rules in v2 -> v3 of Solstice onboarding. Could be subtoken explosion with long contexts causing bigger KV usage per token.
priya (Oncall): Repro notes: I reproduced locally with the sample; p99 jumps when sequence > 30k. Attaching a curl command used to repro.
priya (Oncall): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"solsticev1","input":"<40k tokens>","stream":true}'
```
li (Runtime): On the runtime traces I see KV cache memory thrash and repeated recompute attempts due to partial K/V eviction. That increases latency nonlinearly.
anna (SRE): Any quota/burst autoscale events? I don't want a scale loop making it worse.
dev-bot: autoscale: cluster/solstice-pool scaled +40% at 2026-03-16T14:12Z due to queue depth
mike (Support): Customer is on Dedicated plan and needs this fixed ASAP; they're hitting production timeouts for some users.
carla (ML Eng): Hypothesis: tokenizer change created more subtokens near punctuation which increases per-request cache footprint. Also new attention kernel path may be picking a slower fallback for >X sequence length.
li (Runtime): Confirmed fallback: for >32k we route to the long-seq kernel which has lower parallelism on current gpu config. That's the p99 killer.
priya (Oncall): Proposed mitigations: 1) Rollback tokenizer merges for SolsticeV1 canary -> reduces token count by ~8% per doc. 2) Pin long-seq to the faster kernel (if available) or route to a node pool with upgraded kernel build. 3) Temporarily route heavy long-context requests to SolsticeV1-legacy (older model) while we patch.
anna (SRE): Quick opt: add routing rule to detect >30k tokens and split requests server-side into two segments with KV reattach (fast path) — but that is intrusive.
li (Runtime): Easier: change routing policy to prefer fallback model (solsticev1-smallseq) for long inputs for 2 hours and enable burst capacity on solstice-pool. I'll open a canary rollback PR.
carla (ML Eng): I'll run tokenizer diffs and generate histograms across customer corpora; if merges cause subtoken explosion we revert.
mike (Support): Customer accepted temporary redirect to legacy model for affected routes. They asked for ETA ~4 hours.
priya (Oncall): Action list assigned: li -> routing rollback + burst (ETA 20m). carla -> tokenizer histograms (ETA 1h). anna -> observe and ensure no autoscale thrash (watch). mike -> coordinate with customer.
li (Runtime): Rolling out routing rule: ```json
{"route_condition": "input_tokens>30000", "destination": "solsticev1-legacy"}
```
li (Runtime): Deployed to prod canary (10% hosts) at 4512349920. Monitoring p99 now.
eng-oncall-bot: alert: solstice_p99 dropped from 9.2s -> 3.1s on canary subset
priya (Oncall): Good signal. Apply to 100% while carla investigates.
anna (SRE): I'm watching for queue growth. If queue > 120s we pause rollout.
carla (ML Eng): Tokenizer histo shows merge variant increased average tokens by 6.7% for long docs, and 18% tail in some edge cases (multi-language). Preparing revert PR.
li (Runtime): Full rollout done at 4512349980. p99 back to ~2.9s for affected customers. Revert PR waiting for approval.
mike (Support): Customer notified, they confirmed immediate improvement. Thanks team :thumbsup:
carla (ML Eng): I'll cut a patch to ensure tokenizer preserves previous merge heuristics for long-doc mode; aim to ship tomorrow AM.
priya (Oncall): Postmortem notes: short-term fix was routing rollback; root cause was tokenizer merge change + long-seq kernel fallback. Follow-ups: better canary for long sequences, load tests with >30k tokens, and KV cache eviction heuristics.
mike (Support): Closing loop with customer once patch is in. Will file escalation ticket with timeline.
anna (SRE): Great work. Marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
